name: P greco
dinnerNote: Standard course, 8–10 dishes, priced ¥33,000–38,500 by season (6-dish short course ¥19,800); including tax, plus 10% service
lunchNote: Short course, 6 dishes, weekdays only (standard course also served); including tax, plus 10% service

menus.name: Standard course
menus.note: 8 to 10 dishes; the price moves with the season between ¥33,000 and ¥38,500 (¥30,800–38,500 at lunch); lunch or dinner; including tax, plus a 10% service charge; at least one drink each

menus.name: Short course
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; including tax, plus a 10% service charge; prepaid by card when booking online; at least one drink each

bookingOpens: Online on TableCheck, up to four people. Bookings open to the end of the month two months ahead and close at 3pm the day before. Overseas guests are asked to book online or through their hotel concierge, as English isn't always spoken on the phone.
cancellation: Cancel or change numbers by phone only. 50% of the meal price is charged from two days before, and 100% on the day. Short-course bookings are paid in full by card when booking online. Parties of six or more may have different terms.
groups: Five or more, or a private booking, by phone. The private room takes four or more on the standard course, or six or more on the short course.
dressCode: Smart casual. Guests are asked not to wear strong perfume.
children: Children must be old enough to eat the same course and sit through it. On Saturdays and public holidays children of any age are welcome; children up to junior-high age can order a course or à la carte.
duration: About two hours for the short course and two and a half to three hours for the standard course. The restaurant closes at 9.30pm.
